findings: learner.overview: focus on the whole flowing-water picture and common water meaning. The rare use to write 乞 belongs in expert history, not this first-reading layer.

meaning_history: cited X-227efa4acc063d380c94 and X-cceb04b127548a3d00ef describe 水準 as a compound for a leveling instrument and a standard. They do not establish these as senses of 水 alone. Remove unsupported single-character sense nodes and development edges for those compound meanings. You may retain contextual compound history with its subject clearly identified. Independently inspect or research additional evidence if arguing for a single-character sense. Preserve the sourced water meaning, documented whole-graph borrowing and historical forms.
